Question.title: Question
Question.description: An MCQ question managed from the cloud server question bank.

authorId.description: UID of the instructor/admin who created the question.

authorName.description: Display name of the question author.

subject.description: Subject category (e.g., সাধারণ জ্ঞান, বাংলা, ইংরেজি, গণিত, বিজ্ঞান).

topic.description: Specific chapter or topic of the question.

questionText.description: The stem/prompt of the MCQ question.

correctOptionIndex.description: 0-based index (0 to 3) indicating the correct option.

explanation.description: Detailed explanation or solution note shown after exam submission.

marks.description: Points awarded for a correct answer.

isActive.description: Server control flag: whether this question is active and visible in live student exams.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: An MCQ examination or model test configured and controlled from the cloud server.

creatorId.description: UID of the instructor/admin who created the exam.

creatorName.description: Display name of the exam creator.

subject.description: Subject filter for questions in this exam (or সব বিষয় for all subjects).

description.description: Instructions or syllabus description for students.

totalQuestions.description: Maximum number of MCQ questions included in the exam.

negativeMarkPerWrong.description: Negative mark per wrong answer in hundredths (e.g., 25 = 0.25 mark penalty).

passPercentage.description: Minimum percentage score required to pass.

isPublished.description: Server control flag: whether students can currently see and take this exam.

allowRetake.description: Server control flag: whether students can retake this exam multiple times.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: A student's completed MCQ exam submission and result sheet.

studentId.description: UID of the authenticated student who took the exam.

examId.description: ID of the exam that was taken.

examTitle.description: Title of the exam at the time of submission.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the exam.

answeredCount.description: Number of questions answered by the student.

scoreHundredths.description: Final score multiplied by 100 (e.g., 1450 = 14.50 marks) after negative marking.

maxMarks.description: Maximum possible marks for the exam.

passed.description: Whether the student met the exam passPercentage threshold.

timeTakenSeconds.description: Time spent by the student in seconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/questions/{questionId}.description: Cloud question bank storing MCQ items controlled by instructors/admins and queried by students.

/exams/{examId}.description: Cloud exams and model tests configured by instructors/admins and taken by students.
